name: n8n
description: The official n8n image with a Postgres database, its files on a lasting volume and an HTTPS address. Signs in with the creator's email address and the password shown to the team's owners and admins in the console.

setup.command: node -e 'let p="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>p+=d).on("end",async()=>{const b="http://127.0.0.1:5678";let up=false;for(let i=0;i<120&&!up;i++){up=await fetch(b+"/healthz/readiness").then(r=>r.ok,()=>false);if(!up)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}if(!up)process.exit(3);const r=await fetch(b+"/rest/owner/setup",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({email:process.env.CP_ADMIN_EMAIL,firstName:"Instance",lastName:"Owner",password:p.trim()})});const t=await r.text();process.exit(r.ok||t.includes("already setup")?0:4)})' && touch /home/node/.n8n/.cloudploy-ready
